grammar.title: Harakat chegarasi
grammar.explain: Uzbek combines agglutinative suffix order, case, possession, tense-aspect-mood and evidentiality, participles, converbs, head-final syntax, and prosody. These choices encode participant roles, event boundaries, evidence, focus, and social register.
grammar.pattern: topic + case-marked arguments + suffix chain + clause-final predicate
